text:
FINDING
Engaging a contractor in Valdoria past two years converts the notice obligation: statutory notice runs to 30 days [research: Valdorian Labour Act art. 36, Dz.V. 1974 nr 24 poz. 141].

EVIDENCE
- The declared sources say nothing about notice; this was researched rather than read from them.
- The statute text is the authority for the period [research: Valdorian Labour Act art. 36].

RISKS
- The two-year threshold is stated in the same article; an engagement shorter than that is out of scope here.
